verdict.rationale: Docusign documents multiple natural-language interaction points: the AI-Assisted Review chat lets users 'describe in plain language' what they want and get drafted language (docusign-docs-45, docusign-docs-20), and the Claude MCP connector lets users query agreement status and trigger IAM workflow actions via natural language through an AI assistant (docusign-docs-36, docusign-docs-37, docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12). These are real but narrow to CLM/review and MCP-integrated flows, not the whole e-signature product surface, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of NL command reliability. Missing for 10: first-party evidence that core send/sign/manage workflows can be driven end-to-end by natural language (not just review/chat), and independent corroboration of the MCP/NL experience.
